items.a: Not for every role. Validation and quality need GMP experience; fabricators, technicians and engineers from other process industries learn it here, on a real project file.

items.q: I have not joined PP piping before. Can I apply?
items.a: Yes, if you weld or fuse thermoplastic or metal pipe. The practical interview includes a test joint on our procedure. [qualification offered to fabricators who pass, yes or no]
No. We assess what you have done, wherever you did it. Engineers who sign drawings need a licence in that province.
